# DriveMe

> A driver for your own car in the Helsinki capital region. We collect a
> roadworthy car and drive it where it needs to go — the inspection, a
> workshop, a tyre change, a wash, or another address — and bring it back as
> agreed. We also drive the customer in their own car when they ask for it.
> DriveMe brings the driver, never the car.

- Operator: Mansio Group Oy (DriveMe), Helsinki, Finland
- Service area: Helsinki, Espoo, Vantaa, Kauniainen
- Phone: +358 50 357 2836 · Email: info@driveme.fi
- Languages: Finnish (https://driveme.fi/), English (https://driveme.fi/en/), Swedish (https://driveme.fi/sv/)
- Prices include VAT. Third-party charges (inspection, service, tyres, wash)
  are paid by the customer directly to that provider.
- A request is not a booking: DriveMe calls back and confirms a fixed price
  before anyone drives.

## Services

- [Toimipisteiden välinen siirto](https://driveme.fi/toimipisteiden-valinen-siirto/) — quoted individually. Branch transfer
- [Kotiintoimitus](https://driveme.fi/kotiintoimitus/) — quoted individually. Home delivery
- [Ostoauton nouto](https://driveme.fi/ostoauton-nouto/) — quoted individually. Purchase pickup
- [Huoltosiirto](https://driveme.fi/huoltosiirto/) — from 149 € incl. VAT. Service transfer
- [Auton siirtopalvelu](https://driveme.fi/auton-siirtopalvelu/) — from 89 € incl. VAT. Relocation
- [Oma kuljettaja](https://driveme.fi/oma-kuljettaja/) — quoted individually. Personal driver
- [Yrityksille](https://driveme.fi/yrityksille/) — quoted individually. For companies
